name.value: Middle Beach Lodge At The Beach

description.value: Middle Beach Lodge is a secluded oceanfront retreat spectacularly set on 40 acres of West Coast wilderness, featuring two lodges, twenty rustic self-contained cabins, and newly added treehouse accommodations perched in the forest canopy. The property includes nearly a mile of private beach, rugged headlands, and a hand-cut forest trail system for quiet nature walks. An on-site lounge serves lunch and dinner, and Tofino's eclectic village is just 3km away.
